paragraphs: Rabbi Avin, Rabbi Zeira, and Rabbi Assi were before Rabbi Yochanan. This one received from Rabbi Yochanan with precision, like Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba (see Rav Yitzchak bar Yosef); he was a great sage. Chapter Mi Shemet, 146b: Ravin the elder before Rav Pappa. It appears that in Rabbi Abbahu’s days two sages were called Rabbi Avin, one old and one young (see below, Ravin the elder). Bava Batra 142b: Rabbi Avin, Rabbi Meyasha, and Rabbi Yirmeyah said, etc.; Rabbi Abbahu, Rabbi Chanina bar Pappi, and Rabbi Yitzchak Nappacha said, etc. Rabbi Abbahu asked Rabbi Yirmeyah whether the law followed “us or you.” He replied, “Us, because we are older.” Rabbi Yirmeyah told Rabbi Avin, “When you go there before Rabbi Abbahu.” Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak said: neither Rabbi Avin bar Chiyya nor Rabbi Avin bar Kahana, but unqualified Ravin. What practical difference? To raise a contradiction between his own statements, Kiddushin 44a.
